$comment: Provenance for real provider responses captured by pnpm verify:providers. Fixtures are unmodified upstream payloads (except where truncated, noted per entry). Schemas are written to match these; fixtures are never edited to fit a schema.

fixtures.purpose: Verify the LL2 2.3.0 cursor-paginated envelope and list-mode launch fields.
fixtures.notes: mode=list omits rocket, pad, provider and mission. Detailed mode must be verified separately.

fixtures.purpose: Verify the detailed launch payload before the launches UI depends on rocket, pad, launch provider and mission.
fixtures.notes: launch_service_provider.type is an OBJECT {id,name}, not the bare string used by older LL2 versions. pad.latitude/longitude are numbers. mission can be null. Payload is ~15KB per launch; only consumed fields are modelled.

fixtures.purpose: Verify the Kp product encoding and field names.
fixtures.notes: Array of OBJECTS, not the header-row array-of-arrays many sources describe. time_tag has no timezone designator and must be read as UTC.

fixtures.purpose: Verify solar wind speed, density and IMF components propagated to Earth.
fixtures.notes: Header-row array-of-arrays. products/solar-wind/ does NOT exist (HTTP 404) despite being widely cited.

fixtures.purpose: Verify the NOAA R/S/G space weather scale payload.
fixtures.notes: Object keyed by day offset as strings ("-1","0","1"..). Scale and probability values are strings or null, not numbers.

fixtures.purpose: Independent ISS position for cross-checking local SGP4 output. Verification only, never used to drive the animation.
fixtures.notes: velocity is km/HOUR, not km/s. timestamp is unix SECONDS.

fixtures.purpose: Verify OMM JSON field names consumed by json2satrec, using ISS elements.
fixtures.capturedFrom: GitHub Actions runner; celestrak.org is unreachable from the development network.
fixtures.notes: EPOCH has NO timezone designator and is UTC. NORAD_CAT_ID is a JSON number here and a string from Space-Track.

fixtures.purpose: Verify SATCAT metadata field names: object type, owner, launch site, RCS.
fixtures.notes: Absent values are EMPTY STRINGS, not null: DECAY_DATE and DATA_STATUS_CODE both arrive as "". OBJECT_TYPE is the short code PAY; OPS_STATUS_CODE is +.

fixtures.purpose: Verify the satellite record shape and the sat_id/norad_cat_id linkage.
fixtures.capturedFrom: GitHub Actions runner; db.satnogs.org completes TLS and returns no bytes from the development network.
fixtures.notes: sat_id is SatNOGS's own opaque id, not the NORAD number. status is a free-form string ("in orbit" observed, not just alive/dead/future/re-entered).

fixtures.purpose: Verify transmitter schema: downlink/uplink, mode, baud, status.
fixtures.notes: 50 transmitters for the ISS. Many numeric fields (uplink_high, baud, norad_follow_id) are legitimately null. status is lowercase active/inactive, separate from the alive boolean.
